integrityChecks.interpretation: The test establishes repository-internal consistency of the synthetic trace and recorded v8 audit. It does not establish execution of an official linked VaN3Twin binary or a valid ETSI wire trace.

supported: The v8 generator inserted the fixed-commit text ranges identified as cooperativePerception::receiveCPM, LDM::insert, LDM::lookup, and LDM::getAllIDs into a separately generated C++ translation unit.
The copied receiveCPM text exercised the per-station m_recvCPMmap allocation, object-ID lookup/collision branch, local LDM-ID allocation, and calls to the copied LDM methods under the adapter types.
The repository runner and test hashes still match the hashes recorded by the v8 execution gate.
requiredNarrowing: Describe the result as execution of copied fixed-commit method bodies against synthetic adapters, not execution of official VaN3Twin objects or the official application.

The synthetic translateCPMdata implementation reproduced only the local LDM-ID selection and added harness provenance fields; the full official translation, coordinates, kinematics, timestamps, and container behavior were not executed.
CPBasicService reception, UPER decoding, callback delivery, application lifecycle, and scheduled LDM cleanup remained source-audited only in v8.
unsupported: official ASN.1 object construction or constraint validation

traceContract.oracleFinding: No old-new pseudonym map, stable actor ID, cav_id, truth track ID, or simulator pointer was present in the receiver frame objects. rotationAtMs and the one-physical-object fact were scorer-only oracle metadata. Scorer-only truth is permissible for evaluation, but it cannot validate the policy path and must remain inaccessible to every non-oracle method and attacker.
traceContract.asn1Finding: The v8 objects were ASN-shaped adapter structs only. No ASN.1 constraints, required container relationships, UPER round trip, official decode, or callback delivery were checked. The v9 full-stack gate reports zero valid trace runs.
traceContract.objectRotationFinding: The primary synthetic trace changed stationId and PerceivedObject.objectId together. That is a useful intended condition, but it is not evidence of standards compliance until the official schema accepts the object, object-ID retention/reuse rules are enforced, and the official callback consumes it.
traceContract.sensorRotationFinding: The runner placed sensorId in a synthetic CpmPayload field and did not create a real SensorInformation container. The copied receiveCPM path did not use that field. Therefore v8 did not execute or validate sensor rotation. Sensor ID stability, valid rotation, and permitted SensorInformation omission must be separate conditions; sensor rotation must not be treated as synonymous with mandatory object-ID rotation.
traceContract.stationOnlyFinding: The station-only trace is explicitly nonconformant and may remain only as a negative diagnostic. It must never contribute to the primary effect estimate or standards claim.

duplicateGhostScorer.duplicateDefinitionInV8: max(0, final LDM cardinality minus one)
duplicateGhostScorer.ghostDefinitionInV8: final LDM records whose harness-added perceivedBy differs from the final frame stationId
closure: Both labels rely on scorer truth that the trace has exactly one physical object; they do not generalize to multiple objects or ambiguous association.
The same old-pseudonym record is counted as both a duplicate and a ghost, so the reported values are not distinct failure events.

An old stationId does not by itself make a record a ghost. A ghost must be an externally active receiver output that is unmatched to any extant physical object, or stale state that remains influential beyond its applicable cleanup contract.

A duplicate must be defined by offline truth matching of multiple externally asserted receiver objects to one physical object. Internal hypotheses inside a set-valued method are not duplicates unless exposed as multiple physical objects or hazard claims.

The v8 trace ends at 300 ms, while the source-audited cleanup uses a periodic cleaner and a strictly-greater-than-one-second age condition. Immediate residual state and post-timeout failure are different estimands.
duplicateGhostScorer.evidentiaryStatus: The v8 duplicate=1 and ghost=1 outputs are deterministic adapter diagnostics only and are excluded from pass evidence, consistent with the v9 full-stack gate.

notReached: wire round trip and official decoder

blindReviewReadiness.decision: A full-stack go/no-go is mandatory before blind review. The copied-method adapter cannot substitute for that gate.

identificationThreats.finding: The v8 scorer equates old sender provenance with ghost status and LDM cardinality with duplicates, double-counting one residual record.
identificationThreats.consequence: The observed adapter outcome cannot identify physical ghosting or duplicate world claims.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Freeze truth-based bipartite matching and externally visible hazard-output rules before evaluating any method.

identificationThreats.finding: Only immediate state through 300 ms was observed; the source-defined periodic cleanup and strictly-greater-than-one-second deletion rule were not executed.
identificationThreats.consequence: Legitimate pre-expiry cache retention may be mislabeled as a persistent fault.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Measure immediate transition state, the source-defined expiry boundary, and post-cleanup state as separate estimands.

identificationThreats.finding: The v8 trace bypassed official ASN.1 constraints, UPER, BTP delivery, decode, and callback execution.
identificationThreats.consequence: Adapter behavior may differ from the actual accepted CPM representation and callback path.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Require official encode/decode acceptance and callback delivery for every primary trace.

identificationThreats.finding: Mandatory object-ID renewal was combined with an unexecuted synthetic sensorId change and labeled as one synchronized condition.
identificationThreats.consequence: A result could be attributed to sensor rotation even though the official method never consumed a SensorInformation container.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Factor station plus object rotation, optional valid sensor rotation, and permitted SensorInformation omission into distinct preregistered conditions.

identificationThreats.finding: Scoring requires truth object identity and rotation metadata; v8 kept these out of receiver frames, but no future policy or attacker implementation has yet been audited.
identificationThreats.consequence: A later implementation could accidentally use simulation identity through joins, logs, seeds, or shared state.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Enforce process-level input manifests and tests proving truth fields are available only after frozen method outputs are written.

identificationThreats.finding: The proposed study mentions receiver-side state and an attacker, but no shared observable manifest has been executed.
identificationThreats.consequence: A privacy advantage could be manufactured by denying the attacker fields used by the receiver.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Use byte-identical decoded message, timestamp, kinematic, sensor-description, and radio-metadata streams for receiver and attacker in the primary study.

identificationThreats.finding: The current evidence is one deterministic single-object trace, while future frames, messages, objects, and rotations within a route are dependent.
identificationThreats.consequence: Treating repeated observations as independent would understate uncertainty.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Use the complete independently seeded route episode as the sampling unit and cluster all within-episode observations.

identificationThreats.finding: Cache, tracker, attacker, lock budget, and random state reset behavior has not been demonstrated.
identificationThreats.consequence: Outcomes may depend on execution order or prior episodes.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Start each episode from a fresh process or verify complete teardown with empty-state assertions and order-randomized replay.

identificationThreats.finding: Strong association and attacker baselines have not yet been specified as online-only.
identificationThreats.consequence: Future smoothing with post-rotation observations could unfairly improve either safety or attack reconstruction.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Freeze causal observation cutoffs and report any offline smoother only as a separate attacker upper bound.

identificationThreats.finding: Tsukada-style, JPDA, MHT, and RFS implementations do not yet exist in the audited path.
identificationThreats.consequence: A weak or differently observed baseline could make the candidate appear distinctive without isolating its mechanism.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Validate all baselines on canonical association cases, use the same observation and compute manifests, and freeze tuning before confirmation.

identificationThreats.finding: Bounded lock changes the timing and existence of the treatment rather than merely changing receiver cache behavior.
identificationThreats.consequence: Pooling locked and rotated intervals would obscure whether gains came from handoff or from preventing rotation.
identificationThreats.closureRequirement: Log lock decisions and budgets, analyze each action branch separately, and compare the integrated policy with each component policy.

feasibilityAssessment.sixToTwelveWeekConclusion: Current evidence does not objectively support a schedulable six-to-twelve-week completion of the real path plus strong baselines and independent confirmation.
positiveEvidence: The VaN3Twin source is pinned at commit e722a8d34cb4f5003bc6972bad4b9a456f366731 and the fixed worktree was clean.
The official builder assembled the expected ns-3 and nr source tree.
The host is Ubuntu 22.04 with 24 logical CPUs, a working compiler, CMake, Ninja, OpenSSL, and a discoverable user-prefix OpenCV installation.
The receiver/cache source path and ASN.1 encoder/decoder sources exist in the fixed asset.
blockingEvidence: CMake never generated because libcarla unconditionally required protobuf and gRPC CONFIG after OpenCV was found.
No libautomotive object or shared library was produced, so there is no official object hash or linked execution evidence.
The no-sudo dependency path mixed downloaded Ubuntu packages with the builder-pinned gRPC source path, but gRPC submodule synchronization timed out and no gRPC configure or build was reached.
The filesystem had 59 GB free at 94 percent utilization, and no clean-build storage requirement was measured.
Network throughput was insufficient to finish the recorded gRPC submodule synchronization window.
RAM, swap, sustained build/runtime resource use, and simulation throughput were not recorded.

No real trace generator, official callback driver, timeout replay, pseudonym-change injector, attacker, Tsukada reproduction, JPDA, MHT, RFS, bounded-lock controller, or three-way policy is an executed asset.
feasibilityAssessment.scheduleInterpretation: Public availability and theoretical installability are not readiness evidence. The engineering critical path is still ahead of the research implementation, and the strong-baseline and confirmation workload cannot be estimated from zero full-stack runs.
feasibilityAssessment.decision: Retain only as revise while a clean full-stack go/no-go is attempted. Re-estimate the six-to-twelve-week study only after measured build, replay, cleanup, and throughput evidence exists; reject if that gate fails.

observableContract.receiverAttackerSymmetry: The primary receiver and every primary attacker receive byte-identical observable manifests. Any richer local-sensor study is a separate experiment and cannot support the primary privacy claim.
observableContract.truthBoundary: Physical identity and object existence truth are joined only by the frozen scorer after method and attacker outputs are finalized.

allowed: bounded-horizon candidate sets over current anonymous observations
association weights or set membership used to propagate a spatial or kinematic hazard envelope
uncertainty, age, and expiry attached to the anonymous hazard state
forbidden: sender-keyed trust, reputation, or behavioral history transfer
export of a unique cross-pseudonym identity
retention beyond the preregistered safety horizon or source-defined cache contract
anonymousStateContract.outputRule: The method may output an anonymous set-valued hazard envelope and abstention state. It may not output a persistent person, vehicle, sender, or station link. Internal alternatives count as duplicates only if exposed as multiple physical objects or hazard claims.

policies.reset: On a valid pseudonym change, remove cross-pseudonym association state and create new observations without identity handoff.
policies.timeout: Perform no cross-pseudonym association; retain old cache state only until the unmodified source-defined cleanup contract removes it.
policies.tsukadaStylePointAssociation: Use the paper-faithful causal Kalman and motion-consistency point association, with no simulator identity or post-outcome tuning.
policies.strongAssociation: Run separately validated online JPDA, MHT, and RFS-family trackers using the same observation and compute manifests and without privacy-specific logic.
policies.anonymousSetValuedHandoff: Propagate only an expiring set-valued hazard state across plausible current observations; do not commit or persist an old-new station identity.
policies.boundedLockOnly: Use only an authorized, finite, logged Lock ID Change action; after unlock, complete the compliant rotation without identity handoff.

actions: rotate and use anonymous set-valued hazard handoff
request bounded lock and then complete compliant rotation
threeWay.selectionInputs: Only the shared causal observable manifest, current anonymous uncertainty, remaining authorized lock budget, and credential-validity state.
threeWay.constraints: No repeated lock may evade the cumulative budget or credential boundary. Each action branch is logged and evaluated separately as well as jointly.

safety: truth-matched duplicate external object or hazard assertions
truth objects missing from receiver outputs
a preregistered TTC or collision-risk proxy derived without identity oracle
privacy: attacker point-link precision, recall, and reconstruction outcomes
posterior entropy and effective anonymity set
setQuality: coverage and calibration of association mass

frontierPreregistration.rule: Before confirmation, freeze the safety vector, privacy vector, metric directions, uncertainty procedure, compute budget, lock budget source, and the rule for Pareto dominance. Do not collapse the frontier into an unvalidated weighted score.
frontierPreregistration.thresholdPolicy: This closure supplies no guessed numerical cutoff. Any acceptance bound must be justified from a fixed standard, safety requirement, or development-only calibration and registered before method labels are opened on confirmation episodes.
frontierPreregistration.reporting: Report the complete safety/privacy frontier for every policy and baseline, including dominated and failed operating points.

baselines.requirements: No cross-pseudonym identity, sender history, or trust transfer; new observations start fresh.

baselines.role: separate source cache lifetime from association
baselines.requirements: No association; preserve the official cleanup scheduler and measure immediate, expiry-boundary, and post-cleanup behavior.
Paper-faithful causal state, assignment, and update logic; no truth input and no confirmation tuning.
Validated online implementation with the same observation, motion model disclosure, and compute manifest.
Validated causal implementation; hypothesis pruning and latency are preregistered and reported.
Freeze a validated RFS-family implementation before confirmation so the candidate cannot claim novelty from set terminology alone.
Finite authorized lock budget, credential validity, no anonymous handoff, and complete post-unlock rotation.

baselines.role: component comparator for the three-way selector
baselines.requirements: Use the candidate anonymous state on every eligible rotation without lock selection.
Report separately and never treat as a feasible policy.
Truth may enter only after deployable methods finish; never include this result in receiver or attacker inputs.

controls.requirement: Primary traces must pass official ASN.1 constraints, UPER round trip, CPBasicService decode, callback, full translation, LDM insertion, and scheduled cleanup.
Run methods and attackers from allowlisted manifests in processes that cannot access actor IDs, truth joins, rotation maps, or future records.
Receiver and attacker inputs are byte-identical for the primary experiment; input hashes are stored per episode.
Keep mandatory station/object rotation separate from optional valid sensor rotation and SensorInformation omission; never pool the station-only negative diagnostic.
Score immediate, pre-expiry, cleanup-boundary, and post-cleanup outputs separately; inspect m_recvCPMmap and LDM state independently.
Use frozen offline matching to distinguish duplicate, ghost, missing, and internal hypothesis multiplicity without double-counting one event under incompatible definitions.
Replay each episode manifest across all policies with identical physical, message, network, and pseudonym schedules.
Reset receiver cache, trackers, attacker state, lock budget, random state, and simulator state before every episode and assert empty teardown.
Deployable receiver and attacker comparisons use only causal observations. Any smoother is labeled and reported as a separate offline upper bound.
Use the same observation stream, scenario set, tuning split, disclosed motion assumptions, and measured compute budget for candidate and strong baselines.
Ablate anonymous kinematics, covariance, sensor description, sender trust, and lock independently; sender trust transfer remains forbidden in the candidate.
Freeze code, parameters, metrics, frontier rules, and exclusions before revealing policy labels on held-out confirmation results.

independentUnits.primaryUnit: A complete route-level episode initialized from a fresh process state and defined by its route, traffic-flow seed, network seed, pseudonym schedule, and sensor/message schedule.
independentUnits.repeatedMeasures: Frames, CPMs, physical objects, pseudonym changes, association candidates, and hazard events inside one episode are dependent repeated measures and do not increase the independent sample count.
independentUnits.pairing: The same episode manifest is replayed under every policy. Inference uses paired episode-level contrasts or an episode-clustered procedure fixed in preregistration.
independentUnits.developmentConfirmationSplit: Routes and all seeds used for tuning or threshold calibration are disjoint from frozen confirmation episodes.
independentUnits.sampleSizeRule: Determine the number of independent episodes with a preregistered design analysis using development-only variance or a smallest effect justified by a safety requirement. This closure does not invent a count.
independentUnits.failureHandling: Infrastructure failures are logged before outcomes are opened; reruns use a frozen rule and the original episode identifier remains in the ledger.

successCriteria: The full-stack entry gate passes reproducibly and the corrected scorer demonstrates a real post-rotation safety failure or risk on official decoded traces rather than only an adapter residual.

On held-out episodes, anonymous set-valued handoff improves at least one preregistered safety outcome relative to both hard reset and timeout without worsening another co-primary safety outcome under the frozen decision rule.

The candidate has at least one confirmed non-dominated operating point against Tsukada-style point association, JPDA, MHT, RFS, and bounded-lock-only on the preregistered safety/privacy frontier under the same observables and compute accounting.
The anonymous state audit finds no persistent old-new station identity, sender trust transfer, stable hidden identifier, or exported unique cross-pseudonym link.
A same-observable attacker does not eliminate the candidate's preregistered privacy advantage at the safety-improving operating point.

The three-way policy adds confirmed value beyond each component policy, respects the authorized cumulative lock and credential constraints, and does not degenerate into always locking or always handing off.
Direction and frontier membership reproduce on the frozen confirmation episodes with episode-level uncertainty and without outcome-dependent retuning or exclusions.
killCriteria: A clean pre-provisioned full-stack attempt cannot produce official libautomotive objects and execute the ASN.1-to-cleanup chain reproducibly within the project go/no-go window.
Official ASN.1 constraints or decode reject the primary compliant rotation traces, or the injector requires a nonstandard stable identity field.
The corrected truth-based scorer and executed cleanup path do not reproduce a meaningful duplicate, ghost, missing, or hazard failure attributable to pseudonym rotation.
Any safety gain requires actor ID, cav_id, truth track ID, old-new map, future data, stable sensor fingerprint, sender trust transfer, or other receiver-inaccessible information.
The anonymous method must persist or emit a unique old-new station link to achieve its safety result.
Tsukada-style point association, JPDA, MHT, RFS, or bounded-lock-only dominates every candidate operating point on the frozen safety/privacy frontier.
The same-observable attacker removes every claimed privacy advantage at safety-improving points.
The three-way policy has no incremental value over its frozen component policies or evades privacy by exhausting or repeatedly renewing the lock allowance.
The confirmation result depends on treating frames, messages, objects, or multiple rotations from one episode as independent observations.
Held-out route episodes reverse the preregistered safety conclusion or the result depends on post-outcome tuning, exclusions, or changed scorer definitions.
Measured build, replay, baseline runtime, and confirmation throughput show that the complete study cannot fit the six-to-twelve-week project window.
forbiddenClaims: The v8 harness executed the official VaN3Twin full stack or official libautomotive objects.
The v8 trace was ASN.1 compliant, UPER validated, or accepted by CPBasicService.
The v8 duplicate=1 and ghost=1 values are general physical failure measurements or post-timeout results.
An old record is a ghost solely because its perceivedBy value differs from the newest stationId.
SensorInformation.sensorId rotation was executed or is mandatory whenever objectId rotates.
The station-only negative trace is standards-conformant evidence.
The public repository is asset-ready because its dependencies are theoretically installable.
The six-to-twelve-week completion schedule is feasible on the audited host before a successful build and throughput measurement.
Stable actor IDs, cav_id, truth IDs, simulator pointers, sender trust, or explicit old-new notifications are deployable handoff features.
The candidate preserves privacy merely because it uses a set-valued name or does not export a point ID.
Frames, objects, messages, or pseudonym events are independent samples.
The candidate is ready for blind review before the full-stack go/no-go and frozen preregistration pass.
